description: This file implements the ControlModuleService class and related factory functions for managing IPC control modules, including client connection handling, shared memory retrieval, and control registration and acknowledgment within a media server context.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::server::ipc::ControlModuleService
classes.description: Implements the control module service handling client connections, shared memory access, control registration, and acknowledgments within the IPC framework.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::server::ipc::IControlModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating instances of ControlModuleService.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::server::ipc::ControlModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Concrete factory class for creating ControlModuleService instances.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a new ControlModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ControlModuleService instance with provided playback and control services.

methods.name: ControlModuleService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with playback and control service references.

methods.name: ~ControlModuleService
methods.description: Destructor that removes all controls associated with connected clients.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles new client connection, registers the client, and exports the service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection, removes associated controls, and cleans up.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Retrieves shared memory information via the playback service and responds to the client.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new client, assigns a control ID, and stores the control handle.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment requests for control operations.
